segments.text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings,
he said unto his disciples,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.

segments.speaker: Chief Priests
segments.text: But they said,
Not on the feast day,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: lest there be an uproar among the people.
¶ Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying,

segments.speaker: Disciples
segments.text: To what purpose is this waste?

segments.speaker: Disciples
segments.text: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
When Jesus understood it, he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
¶ Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
And said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you?
And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
¶ Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
And as they did eat, he said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Lord, is it I?
And he answered and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Master, is it I?
He said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Thou hast said.
¶ And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Take, eat; this is my body.
And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Drink ye all of it;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
Then saith Jesus unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
Peter answered and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Peter
segments.text: Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus said unto him,
Verily I say unto thee, That

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
Peter said unto him,

segments.speaker: Peter
segments.text: Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee.
Likewise also said all the disciples.
¶ Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples,

segments.speaker: Peter
segments.text: Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
Then saith he unto them,

segments.speaker: Peter
segments.text: My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying,

segments.speaker: Peter
segments.text: O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: and saith unto Peter,
What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying,

segments.speaker: second time He went away and
segments.text: O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them,

segments.speaker: second time He went away and
segments.text: Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

segments.speaker: second time He went away and
segments.text: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
¶ And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying,

segments.speaker: second time He went away and
segments.text: Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said,

segments.speaker: second time He went away and
segments.text: Hail, master;
and kissed him.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And Jesus said unto him, Friend,
wherefore art thou come?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus,
and took him.
And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Then said Jesus unto him,
Put up again thy sword into his place:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.
Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
¶ And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
And said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
And the high priest arose, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: The high priest stood up and
segments.text: Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
But Jesus held his peace.

segments.speaker: The high priest
segments.text: And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus saith unto him,
Thou hast said:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: What think ye?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: They answered and said,
He is guilty of death.
Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
Saying,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
¶ Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: T
hou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
But he denied before them all,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: saying, I know not what thou sayest.
And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
And again he denied with an oath,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: I do not know the man.
And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
Then began he to curse and to swear,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: saying, I know not the man.
And immediately the cock crew.
And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
